name: one-arm-seated-bent-over-dumbbell-reverse-fly.html
instructions:
1. Grab a dumbbell with a neutral grip and sit on the edge of a flat bench.
2. Allow your arm to hang by your side. You can place your non-working forearm across your knee for stability.
3. Bring your torso forward by bending at the waist. Keep your head up and your eyes facing forward. This is the starting position.
4. Take a deep breath and pull the dumbbell towards the ceiling using the rear deltoids, until parallel or as much as your range of motion allows.
5. Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position under control.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, and then repeat on your opposite arm.
